_comment: Lightning 2.0 Phase 2, domain and database extensions. Seven new relations, all created empty, all with RLS enabled, all revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated and explicitly granted to service_role (BYPASSRLS bypasses row security and is not a table privilege). lightning_pool_session is a participation period subordinate to cash_player_session, one open per player per cluster, holding only what is true of the PLAYER. lightning_pool_slot is one of the player's simultaneous Lightning tables under that session, holding everything true of a TABLE: orbit position, wait percentiles, per-table counters and when that table opened and closed - because a multi-tabling player has three independent orbits and three wait distributions, and a percentile cannot be merged across them. lightning_instance is a disposable one-hand container, deliberately not a row in public.tables. lightning_reservation is a matcher hold with an expiry, keyed to a slot, shape copied from cash_seat_moves. lightning_blind_ledger is per player per cluster blind DEBT and fairness TOTALS, which nothing persisted before Lightning (it lived in engine memory and was lost on every restart). lightning_hand and lightning_hand_player carry the Lightning dimensions of a hand as a side table keyed by hand_id, rather than nine columns on the 14 GB hand_history. cash_cluster_events gains cluster_epoch integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. No matcher, no population predicate, no conversion, no formation: Phases 6, 4, 5 and 9.
